description: This file defines React components and TypeScript types for application-wide providers and context setup in a Next.js project, including theme, feature flags, session, and external integrations.

methods.name: getEmbedNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the embed namespace from URL search parameters or window object for embed mode detection.

methods.name: CalcomThemeProvider
methods.description: Provides theme context with support for embed mode and dynamic styling based on embed namespace.

methods.name: FeatureFlagsProvider
methods.description: Provides feature flags context to child components.

methods.name: useOrgBrandingValues
methods.description: Retrieves organization branding info from user session.

methods.name: OrgBrandProvider
methods.description: Provides organization branding context to child components.

methods.name: AppProviders
methods.description: Main application provider component that composes various context providers based on page type and configuration.
